newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac and ANZ rally on Wallis talk.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac and ANZ rally on Wallis talk.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp Ltd and Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, seen the most vulnerable to takeover bids if merger rules are eased, continued their sharp rally of recent days in active early Monday trade.

Brokers and analysts said the impending release of the official Wallis inquiry report into financial regulation had reignited talks that Westpac and ANZ would be the subject of takeover offers after the release of the report.
"Expectations are rising that Wallis could lead to mergers," said ABN AMRO banking analyst Michael Pulman.
Westpac was up 12 cents at A$7.40 at 11.50 a.m. (0050 GMT) on volume of 1.03 million shares, having rallied five percent from A$7.04 in the past week.
ANZ was up 15 cents at A$8.25 on volume of 1.78 million shares, having risen seven percent from A$7.70 in the past week against a market overall that has fallen 1.3 percent.
Brokers said the strong buying appeared to be offshore based.
"It's all on Wallis from offshore," said one Sydney broker.
